story_type: child basket hoist from flooded street, camera on the basket
hook: This child was carried through a flood, then lifted out.
narration: This child was carried through a flood, then lifted out in a basket.
It was Hurricane Harvey, near Port Arthur, Texas.
An Air Force pararescueman set the child down inside the steel rescue basket.
A basket is used because a small child can't be held safely in a sling. The steel frame keeps them inside.
Then the cable pulled tight, and the rooftops dropped away below.
The camera was clipped to the basket, looking straight up at the Pave Hawk.
outcome: The child was brought up to a fellow pararescueman aboard the HH-60G Pave Hawk.
title: Child hoisted out of Harvey floodwater
description:
During Hurricane Harvey on Aug. 30, 2017, near Port Arthur, Texas, a 308th Rescue Squadron pararescueman brought a child to a fellow pararescueman for transport in an HH-60G Pave Hawk helicopter, filmed from a camera on the rescue basket.

Footage: U.S. Air Force, 308th Rescue Squadron, Patrick Air Force Base, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/590199/hurricane-harvey-rescue
